title: mmt-bench ruleset definition
description: One rulesets/<id>.yaml file (issue #10): a rule set defined reproducibly, not the rules themselves — the .so files are extracted from the pinned image into local/ and never committed.

tool.description: The adapter the rule set is for (mmt-probe).

rules.description: The .so file or the directory holding the rule set's .so files, relative to the repository root.

allow_empty.description: True when zero rules are the point (r0, r0b); the adapter refuses an empty staging without it, so a silently missing extraction still fails the run.

enable.description: What the tool's config writes for security.enable: false is R0 (security off), true with zero rules is R0b (engine on, nothing to match).

source.description: Where the rules come from, with the pin (image digest, commit).

expect_rules.description: How many .so files the rules path is expected to hold; matrix.load reports a different count.

extract.description: The command that produces the rules path when it is missing.
